question: Where can I download the app?
answer: Choose the App Store for an iPhone or Google Play for an Android device. Use the download buttons below to visit the correct store and install Locust.

question: Can I continue to use Locust on the web?
answer: Yes. Locust will continue to support the v2 module on the web.

question: How do I find the meeting for field service (MFS)?
answer: Use the video guide to find your upcoming meeting for field service, review its details, and get directions.

question: Where do I find emergency, parking, and other information for my shift?
answer: To find emergency locations, parking, and other important information for your shift, open the location schedule for your assigned shift and look for the "Location Info & Resources" option.

question: How do I navigate to the emergency locations on my shift?
answer: Open the location schedule for your assigned shift and select "Location Info & Resources." On this page, you'll find a PDF containing emergency information and locations. The page may also include GPS navigation links to help you quickly locate emergency resources when needed.

question: Where do I view all my shifts?
answer: You can view all of your shifts by selecting the “schedule” option in your app. In there you should see a calendar with all of your shifts marked.

question: Where do I set time away?
answer: The add Time Away option can be found at the top of the app's home page, or on the Time Away section on the website home page Select this option to enter the start and end dates for your time away. You can also include optional notes to provide any additional information.

question: Where do I change my availability?
answer: The  My Availability option can be found at the top of the app's home page or, on the website, in the Zone Availability section of your schedule. Select this option to enter the times you are available to work a shift. You can also include optional notes to provide any additional information.

question: I am a new volunteer. How do I access other locations in the app?
I locked myself out of my Locust account. What should I do?
answer: Try these steps to regain access to your Locust account:
steps: Check that you are using the email address connected to your volunteer account.
Check for extra spaces and confirm that Caps Lock is off.
Select Forgot password? and follow the account-recovery instructions at https://locustspw.org/v2/login-help.
Open the reset email and follow its secure link.
If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder before contacting support.
tip: Security tip: Support should never ask you to share your password.
